name: Tiny ImageNet
description: Tiny ImageNet is a 200-class image classification dataset containing 100,000 color images at 64×64 pixels, with 500 training images and 50 validation images per class.
citation: Tiny ImageNet Visual Recognition Challenge, Stanford CS231n. https://tiny-imagenet.herokuapp.com/
